fields.description: Difficulty option byte at the start of the option block
fields.evidence: Option block persists via the EEPROM serial write path FUN_080df464, which bit-serializes the request word and clocks data words out to 0x0D000000 through the DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4, and is read back on boot through FUN_080df514. Logical offset 0x00 holds value 0x01 in baseline.
fields.name: option_difficulty

fields.description: Second option byte next to difficulty (round/time style setting)
fields.evidence: Same EEPROM option-block path as option_difficulty: written by FUN_080df464 and read back by FUN_080df514 via DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4. Logical offset 0x01 holds value 0x01 in baseline.
fields.name: option_battle_timer

fields.description: Top ranking-table entry score (u32, decreases monotonically down the table)
fields.evidence: Ranking table entries persist through the EEPROM write path FUN_080df464 and read path FUN_080df514 via DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4. Logical offset 0x18 holds the top entry u32 score 196608 (0x00030000); following entries step down by 0x1000 (167936, 163840, ...), confirming a score column.
fields.name: ranking_top_score

fields.evidence: Ranking entry initials stored alongside scores through FUN_080df464 / FUN_080df514 via FUN_080df3e4. Logical offset 0x1C holds bytes 52 59 55 00 ('RYU'), and the next entry at logical 0x2C holds 'KEN', matching the on-screen fighter initials.
fields.name: ranking_top_name

fields.evidence: Same ranking-table EEPROM path (write FUN_080df464, read FUN_080df514, DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4). Logical offset 0x28 holds 167936 (0x00029000), exactly 0x1000 below the top entry, confirming the score column layout.
fields.name: ranking_second_score

fields.evidence: Same ranking-table EEPROM path (write FUN_080df464, read FUN_080df514, DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4). Logical offset 0x2C holds bytes 4B 45 4E 00 ('KEN').
fields.name: ranking_second_name

fields.description: Option select byte in the tail option cluster (small selector 0-5)
fields.evidence: Tail option cluster persists via the EEPROM write path FUN_080df464 and read path FUN_080df514 through DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4. Logical offset 0x13C4 holds value 0x03 next to a 0..5 lookup pattern at 0x13A0, consistent with an option cursor/selection byte.
fields.name: option_select_a

fields.description: Option select byte next to option_select_a
fields.evidence: Same tail option cluster EEPROM path (write FUN_080df464, read FUN_080df514, DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4). Logical offset 0x13C5 holds value 0x02, within the 0..5 selector range.
fields.name: option_select_b

fields.description: Option toggle flags byte in the tail option cluster
fields.evidence: Same tail option cluster EEPROM path (write FUN_080df464, read FUN_080df514, DMA primitive FUN_080df3e4). Logical offset 0x13C6 holds value 0x01, consistent with a small toggle/flag byte.
fields.name: option_toggles
